packageRules.description: This project tracks the Scala 3 LTS line, currently 3.9.x. `scala` is the name the built-in sbt manager uses; the glob covers everything else under the organisation.
Scotty is built from its release tag by CI, not resolved from a registry.
Group the two build definitions so sbt and Mill never drift apart.
sbt 2.x is a breaking change to the build definition. Stay on the 1.x line until that migration is done deliberately. `sbt/sbt` is the name the built-in sbt manager uses for project/build.properties.
Same for Mill: a future 2.x would change the build API, so take it on purpose rather than by pull request.

description: The built-in sbt manager cannot resolve this one. %%% in build.sbt is the
Scala.js cross-version operator, so the artifact carries both suffixes --
_sjs1_3 -- while the sbt manager only appends _3:
That produced the 'Failed to look up sbt-package package
org.scala-js:scalajs-dom_3' warning on the dashboard. Disabled here so the
sbt manager stops retrying an impossible name; the customManager below
Note this is build.sbt, not build.mill -- the existing Mill regex manager
maps mvn"org::artifact" to _3, which is right for the JVM module.

customManagers.description: Scala dependencies in the Mill build: `mvn"org::artifact:version"` resolves to the _3 artifact
Java dependencies in the Mill build: `mvn"org:artifact:version"`
Python reference tooling pinned in the uv script header
